entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese fish species/label mismatch at Hamada station3 and all12 full target/hint sets. Verified one differently shaped fish not moved alone, box not sent weighing, whole-box inspection hold plus verbal transport alert, original tag after senior check and adjacent box while awaiting result. Repaired telegraphic Tagalog/Hindi/Nepali sentences and tasks to restore complete case-specific meaning.

Read Japanese similar-named highway-bus stop versus friend meeting point and all12 full target/hint sets.
